data.title: Rising Waters
data.passage: Heavy rains fill mountain streams with too much water. As a result, fast currents wash away soil and dirt. To fix this, workers build tall walls along the riverbanks. People also plant extra trees to hold the earth in place.

structureOptions.label: Problem and Solution

structureOptions.label: Cause and Effect
structureOptions.description: Shows why something happens and what happens because of it.
